name: Alistair Humphrey
bio: Alistair Humphrey's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying engineering at university, he volunteered at a local racing team, quickly discovering a passion for the technical and strategic aspects of the sport. After graduating, he worked his way up through various engineering roles, eventually transitioning into team management. Alistair believes in a data-driven approach, always seeking marginal gains through meticulous analysis and optimization. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to foster a collaborative environment, believing that a united team is essential for success. His pragmatic approach and sharp eye for detail distinguish him from more flamboyant team principals.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is a man of average height with a slightly weathered face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Insists on drinking Earl Grey tea at precisely 3:00 PM every day.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when under stress.
